name: Defender
desc: An unaffiliated arcade homage: fly through a wraparound world, shoot invading aliens, and rescue the humanoids they abduct. Original code-drawn graphics and synthesized sound; no external assets or runtime dependencies.
controls: Enter start; Left/Right arrows steer; Z thrust; X reverse/flip; Q/A or Up/Down climb/dive; Space or Ctrl fire; S or Shift smart bomb; H hyperspace; P pause; M mute. Touch controls on phones (landscape recommended).
creator: GarethDaviesLondon
